problem_statement: This Starbucks storefront (Vue 2 / vue-cli, history-mode router) has a shared header with a live cart badge and needs a merchandising system that stays consistent across pages. Add a shared 'Roast lineup' rail that renders on the Home, Menu, and Our Story routes: a short intro plus four responsive metric tiles (Signature roast, Cold brew steep, Seasonal, Whole bean price) in the deep-pine Starbucks palette (#1e3932 ground, #017143 accent). The tile row must wrap fluidly so there is no horizontal overflow on a 390px phone. On the Menu page, wire each product's 'Add to cart' button so it commits to the shared store and the header 'Cart · N' badge updates live on every click. Keep the existing hero, navigation, and product cards intact.
required_content: A shared 'Roast lineup' rail rendered on the Home, Menu, and Our Story routes.
Four metric tiles (Signature roast, Cold brew steep, Seasonal, Whole bean price) using the Starbucks pine/green palette.
A responsive tile row that wraps and produces zero horizontal overflow at 390px.
Each Menu 'Add to cart' button commits to the shared cart store.
The header 'Cart · N' badge reflects the live cart count after every add.
design_constraints: Use the on-brand Starbucks deep-pine (#1e3932) rail ground with #017143 green accents; do not introduce an off-brand light/cream palette.
The rail must appear on all three whitelisted routes (Home, Menu, Our Story), not only the home page.
The metric tile row must wrap on narrow viewports; no fixed-width non-wrapping row.
The cart badge must read the reactive store count, not a snapshot captured at component setup.
state_constraints: Capture Home at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths to prove the rail wraps with no overflow.
Capture the Menu add-to-cart click states to prove the header cart badge updates live.

change_completion: The Roast lineup rail is present with its intro and four metric tiles.
Each Menu Add-to-cart button updates the header Cart · N badge.
design_consistency: The rail uses the on-brand Starbucks pine/green palette on every route.
The rail renders identically across Home, Menu, and Our Story.
responsive: The metric tile row wraps on a 390px phone with zero horizontal overflow.
The layout stays clean at tablet and desktop widths.
regression: The existing hero, navigation, and product cards remain intact.
No off-brand palette or placeholder copy is introduced.

author_notes: L4 with four orthogonal gates on the Starbucks storefront. D6 no_horizontal_overflow: the Roast lineup metric-tile row must wrap (reference flex 1 1 180px = 0px; baseline fixed 820px nowrap = 470px mobile overflow; bad 600px nowrap margin:0 = 292px). D3 visual_regression: rail palette on Home desktop+mobile (baseline keeps the on-brand pine and passes; bad uses an off-brand cream #f2ead9 ground with brown metrics so pixelmatch/ssim/block_fidelity all fail). D2 dom_assertions cross-page: the rail renders on Home, Menu, and Our Story (baseline and bad render it on Home only, failing the Menu and Our Story assertions). D4 interaction_assertions: clicking Add to cart updates the header 'Cart · N' badge (baseline wires the store correctly and passes D4 — leg-orthogonal; bad snapshots the count into a non-reactive local at setup so the badge stays 'Cart · 0'). Roast lineup rail, Starbucks roast merchandising, thumb assets, cart badge — design keywords.
